blurb.text: A state whose vineyards are mostly in the south, inside the Southeastern New England AVA. Many wineries rely on cold-hardy hybrids such as Seyval, Vidal blanc and Maréchal Foch. Martha's Vineyard has a milder climate, and Nashoba Valley is a warmer inland AVA.
